server start
skygo artifacts upload source
cp stdout ref.json
fault download-offset
! skygo artifacts download --ref ref.json bad-offset
stderr 'invalid or partial download chunk'
! exists bad-offset
fault download-bytes
! skygo artifacts download --ref ref.json bad-bytes
stderr 'validate downloaded archive|digest does not match'
! exists bad-bytes
# Both failed reads release their actual fixed leases. A subsequent unmodified
# transfer succeeds, proving the fault was consumed and bytes were not cached.
calls CloseArtifactDownload 2
skygo artifacts download --ref ref.json good
cmp source/seed.txt good/seed.txt
calls BeginArtifactDownload 3
calls CloseArtifactDownload 3
calls SubmitWorkspaceJob 0
server stop
! stderr .
-- source/seed.txt --
seed
